column2: A 77.9%~100% Transmission Efficiency Hybrid Packet/Circuit-Switched Network-on-Chip with a Pattern-Based Synchronizer-Less Data Transfer Scheme
column4: To minimize latency and improve transmission efficiency, this article proposes a data transfer scheme for the globally-ratiochronous locally-synchronous (GRLS) system, in which the transmitter delivers pattern-based data and the receiver captures it through a synchronizer-less interface. Measurement results in a hybrid network-on-chip (NoC) indicate that the transfer latency achieves an approximate 22.8% reduction over one flip-flop-based FIFO and the transmission efficiency exceeds 77.9%.

column2: A 28-nm Optical Flow Estimation Accelerator with Redundancy Speculation, Bit-Width-Aware Compression and Similarity Detection
column4: Optical flow estimation with event-based cameras could capture per-pixel motion field efficiently for intelligent scenarios. However, numerous redundant operations and large unnecessary external-memory-access (EMA) hinder its expected high-efficiency. To alleviate this, we demonstrate an accelerator with redundancy speculation, bit-width-aware compression and similarity detection, decreasing overall operations and EMA to 0.20x and 0.08x, while reducing corresponding energy and latency cost to 0.12x and 0.19x, respectively. In evaluation, an EMA-included energy efficiency of 14.07 TOPS/W is achieved.
